recommendation_rationale: basis=max (214.0 tokens); recommended_max_seq_len=256 adds a 5% margin over the true maximum combined length and rounds up to the nearest multiple of 32. The max (214) is not a large outlier vs. p99 (211.2, ratio 1.01), so rounding up from the true max truncates zero examples and loses zero assistant targets -- there is no tradeoff to make at this dataset size. 384 and 512 were also measured at 0 truncated examples but were rejected because they add activation-memory cost with no data-preservation benefit over 256. Human-approved from the real Colab tokenizer run before being written into configs/qlora_config.json.
